title: Reversing Order of Integration for a Non-Elementary Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate int_0^1 int_y^1 sin(x^2) dx dy by reversing the order of integration.

steps.title: Identify and Sketch Region of Integration
steps.mathExpression: D = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \le y \le 1, \; y \le x \le 1\} = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \le x \le 1, \; 0 \le y \le x\}
steps.explanation: The region is a triangle bounded by y = 0, x = 1, and the diagonal line y = x.
steps.why: Translating Type II limits into Type I form.

steps.title: Set Up Reversed Iterated Integral
steps.explanation: Integrate over y first from 0 to x.

steps.title: Evaluate Inner Integral
steps.explanation: Since sin(x^2) is constant with respect to y, the inner integral produces factor x.
steps.why: Generating the required derivative factor x.

steps.title: Evaluate Outer Integral via Substitution
steps.explanation: Use substitution u = x^2, du = 2x dx.
